people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”
translations.bsb: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, “What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!”
translations.kjv: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone
translations.asv: And Moses cried unto Jehovah, saying, What shall I do unto this people? They are almost ready to stone me.
